name: Seinfeld
description: A slap-bass study in the style of a 90s sitcom theme — original lines in E minor at 112 bpm, not a transcription of the show's theme — plus a tour of every MIDI channel and GM instrument. Rows 1-4 drums (ch 10), 5-8 slap SUBROUTINES that 9-B string together (ch 13), C keys (ch 15), D guitar (ch 14), E horns (ch 16), F-G lead (ch 11), H-J subroutines for the tours, K-O sections, P a channel check, Q-X instrument tours per channel (p range loops), Y-Z all 128 GM sounds. Row 0 plays the song. Program changes are heard only with a GM synth (DLSMusicDevice) on the Logic tracks.
prompt: a new MPL Bank called Seinfeld which seeks to recreate the seinfeld theme slap bass with a demonstration of all of the MIDI channels and instruments

slots.name: seinfeld
slots.note: MAIN: intro (bass + pops), groove, groove 2, full band, outro — 20 bars

slots.name: sfHat
slots.note: Closed hi-hat 16ths

slots.name: sfGroove
slots.note: Funk groove: syncopated kick, snare on 2 and 4; launches the hat 16ths

slots.name: sfPops
slots.note: Wood-block pops (GM has no mouth pops — high and low wood block stand in)

slots.name: kitBeat
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: plain one-bar beat for the drum-kit tour (no m#/p#: the caller sets them)

slots.name: slap1
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: slap bar 1 — thumb on the low E, popped octaves, a G-A hammer

slots.name: slap2
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: slap bar 2 — chromatic climb to A

slots.name: slapFill
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: one-bar fill down and up the E minor pentatonic, ends on a high pop

slots.name: slapOct
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: octave pops, thumb-pop-rest-pop

slots.name: bassA
slots.note: 4 bars of slap bass (Slap Bass 1)

slots.name: bassB
slots.note: 4 bars, octave version (Slap Bass 2)

slots.name: slapEnd
slots.note: Ending: run up, high pop, low E rings

slots.name: sfKeys
slots.note: Electric piano stabs, Em Em A Em

slots.name: sfGtr
slots.note: Muted guitar 16th skank on the off-16ths

slots.name: sfHorns
slots.note: Brass section hits in the 4th bar

slots.name: sfLead
slots.note: Saw-lead answer in bars 3-4

slots.name: leadLick
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: 2-bar E minor pentatonic lick (the lead row and the lead tour call it)

slots.name: gtrRiff
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: one-bar guitar riff for the guitar tour

slots.name: keysComp
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: one bar of Em stabs for the piano and organ tours

slots.name: padChord
slots.note: SUBROUTINE: one bar of chords for the strings and brass tours

slots.name: intro
slots.note: SECTION: slap bass alone with wood-block pops

slots.name: groove
slots.note: SECTION: bass, drums, electric piano

slots.name: groove2
slots.note: SECTION: octave bass, muted guitar, saw-lead answer

slots.name: hits
slots.note: SECTION: everyone — channels 10, 11, 13, 14, 15 and 16 at once

slots.name: outro
slots.note: SECTION: last groove bar, then the crash under the low E

slots.name: chanCheck
slots.note: CHANNEL CHECK: two beats on each amp in turn — 10 drums (D), 11 lead (V), 13 bass (B), 14 guitar (G), 15 keys (P), 16 strings (O). Ch 12 is empty.

slots.name: tourBass
slots.note: TOUR: the slap bar on all 8 GM basses, p32-39 (acoustic, finger, pick, fretless, slap 1-2, synth 1-2)

slots.name: tourLead
slots.note: TOUR: the lead lick on all 8 GM synth leads, p80-87

slots.name: tourGtr
slots.note: TOUR: the riff on all 8 GM guitars, p24-31 (nylon … distortion, harmonics)

slots.name: tourPiano
slots.note: TOUR: Em stabs on the 8 GM pianos, p0-7

slots.name: tourOrgan
slots.note: TOUR: the 8 GM organs, p16-23 (drawbar … accordion, harmonica)

slots.name: tourStrings
slots.note: TOUR: strings and ensembles, p40-55 (violin … orchestra hit)

slots.name: tourBrass
slots.note: TOUR: brass and reeds, p56-71 (trumpet … clarinet)

slots.name: tourKits
slots.note: TOUR: the GM drum kits — standard, room, power, electronic, TR-808, jazz, brush, orchestra, SFX (only a GM synth switches kits)

slots.name: gmTour1
slots.note: TOUR: every GM sound 0-63, two beats each (pianos to brass)

slots.name: gmTour2
slots.note: TOUR: every GM sound 64-127 (reeds to sound effects)
